message.content: **MSFT** is the ticker symbol for **Microsoft Corporation**, one of the largest publicly‑traded companies worldwide. On Yahoo Finance you’ll see “MSFT” used to identify all data related to Microsoft’s shares—price charts, financial statements, news releases, analyst ratings, dividend history, earnings reports, and more. It’s traded under this symbol on the Nasdaq Stock Market (NASDAQ: MSFT).
